rules.summary: Confirm monorepo or multirepo from the manifest before any cross-app decision
A trigger maps to one sub-guide
tokens: Read the sub-guide for the change

rules.summary: Extend the existing module installer, never a parallel install path; mirror the closest existing module
A controller is done when its module registration, RBAC, OpenAPI tag, DTOs, tests and (monorepo) regenerated api-client exist
tokens: module registration, RBAC, OpenAPI tag, DTOs and tests

rules.summary: A failing drift-guard test is fixed on both sides, never disabled
Extend the installer, never bypass a drift guard, never half-finish a wiring, always confirm topology
tokens: Never invent a parallel install path

retired.reason: Split into mirror-what-exists, finish-the-wiring and drift-guard-stays-enabled, each a step or a positive instruction; "always confirm topology" is step 1 and topology.md (Editing discipline on monorepo); "never add comments that explain WHAT" was a no-op the model obeys by default

rules.summary: A sub-guide that is not there is reported, and the closest module is mirrored

retired.reason: The branch cannot occur: the three sub-guides ship with the skill and the stories of Epic #305 landed long ago; its fallback (mirror the closest existing module) is the rule mirror-what-exists

rules.summary: Module, controller, service, DTO and test layout of an API module
Permissions are declared on the controller with RequirePermissions and seeded in the dataset
Schema changes are migration-free: multi-file schema and db push
Requests use a Zod factory shared with the frontend; responses use class-validator
Pages are lazy-loaded under private or public, and routed in one place
API hooks keep stable query keys; forms use React Hook Form with a shared Zod factory
Translations are YAML keys, never inline strings
On a monorepo the workspace package is canonical and the app copy is a byte-identical mirror; a multirepo has no canonical
The generated typed API client exists on a monorepo only; call it directly or wrap it
